subject: general
question: In July 2024, the first Project PARI (Public Art of India), an initiative by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, was organised in which of the following locations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first Project PARI (Public Art of India) was launched in **New Delhi** in July 2024.
 
• Project PARI is an initiative by the **Ministry of Culture, Government of India**.
 
• The project aims to **promote public art** and create a platform for artists across India to showcase their work.
 
• It includes various forms of art installations, murals, and sculptures in public spaces to enhance the cultural landscape of the city.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Culture**

 
 
• The Ministry of Culture is responsible for the preservation and promotion of art and culture in India.
 
• It oversees various cultural institutions, museums, and galleries across the country.
 
• The ministry also organizes cultural events, festivals, and exhibitions to promote India's rich heritage.
 
 
 
• **Public Art**
 
 
• Public art refers to artworks that are created for public spaces and are accessible to everyone.
 
• It includes sculptures, murals, installations, and performances.
 
• Public art plays a significant role in enhancing the aesthetic appeal of urban areas and promoting cultural expression.
 
 
 
• **Art Installations**
 
 
• Art installations are large-scale, three-dimensional works designed to transform the perception of a space.
 
• They can be temporary or permanent and often interact with the environment and audience.
 
• Installations are a popular form of public art used to convey social, political, and cultural messages.
 
 
 
• **Murals**
 
 
• Murals are large paintings or artworks applied directly to walls, ceilings, or other permanent surfaces.
 
• They are often used to depict historical events, cultural stories, or social issues.
 
• Murals can transform public spaces and contribute to the visual identity of a community.
